responsibility: This file implements the runtime support for opt_problem, GCC’s mechanism for capturing rich “missed optimization” failure information while preserving a simple success/failure API for optimization code. It constructs opt_problem objects from dump locations and printf-style messages, immediately emits them to active dump destinations while retaining the underlying optinfo items for later replay higher in the call stack, manages the singleton current problem, and provides selftests that verify propagation and re-emission behavior through opt_result-based failure handling.
same_name_distinction: Implements the opt_problem machinery declared in opt-problem.h: constructing the singleton problem object, immediately dumping and retaining optinfo payloads, re-emitting them via emit_and_clear, and hosting the selftests for propagation behavior. Unlike the header, it contains the runtime state and executable logic rather than the wrapper class/interface definitions.
